DRAFT – requires salesperson approval – availability unconfirmed
Not sendable as an offer

Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. We can't meet the request exactly as written. You asked for a facilitator for the whole 4-hour workshop. Our facilitator covers 2 hours only, and we have no longer facilitator option.

The rest of your request fits. The Studio holds up to 12 people, so it suits your group of 10, and it comes as a 4-hour block. The closest package we can offer is the Studio with the facilitator for 2 hours. It stays within your budget, as the table shows:



| Item | Detail | Price |
|---|---|---:|
| Studio (V1) | 4 hours | €240 |
| Facilitator (S4) | one facilitator for 2 hours | €280 |
| **Total** | | **€520** |
| Budget | | €600 |
| Difference | | €80 under budget |



These are the options. Each one needs your agreement, because each gives something up:



| Option | Package | People | Total | What the client gives up |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | Studio | 10 | €240 | Facilitator (a stated requirement) is removed |
| 2 | Studio + Facilitator | 10 | €520 | facilitator covers 2 hours only, not the requested 4 |

Every option changes a stated requirement and needs the client's explicit consent.



- Option 1 is the Studio alone. You give up the facilitator, which you listed as a requirement.
- Option 2 is the Studio with the facilitator. You give up facilitation for the second half of the workshop, because the facilitator covers 2 hours, not 4.

You didn't mention accessibility, so I have assumed nobody in your group needs wheelchair access. The Studio is reached by stairs only and is not wheelchair accessible. If anyone needs a route without stairs, please tell us. The Loft is wheelchair accessible, and we would then need to review the package.

The listed prices are fixed. Availability for your date has to be checked separately, and nothing is held at this stage.

Please tell us which option you would like, or whether you have any questions.

Kind regards
